title: What’s in a Name? Auditing Large Language Models for Race and Gender Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using names strongly associated with Black and White individuals, evaluating continuous quantitative outcomes (e.g., salary offers, purchase prices, probabilities) generated by the models.

Counterfactual name substitution in prompts using names strongly associated with male and female identities, evaluating continuous quantitative outcomes (e.g., salary offers, purchase prices, probabilities) generated by the models.
